name: Geargrafx
description:
Geargrafx is an open-source PC Engine and TurboGrafx-16 console emulator and debugger written in C++. It delivers accurate hardware emulation of the classic NEC 16-bit video game console.

Features:
- Precise HuC6280 CPU and HuC6270 video display controller emulation
- High-fidelity HuC6260 PSG sound generator emulation
- Supports HuCard ROM image files with automatic region detection
- Built-in debugger, memory viewer, and disassembly tools for development
- Customizable video filters, aspect ratio correction, and gamepad mapping
